description: Scrape Google News by keyword with optional full-text and image extraction.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for regional news (e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'DE', 'IN').
country.title: Country

dateFrom.description: Filter articles published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides dateRange.
dateFrom.title: Date From

dateRange.description: Filter articles by recency. Ignored if dateFrom/dateTo are set.
dateRange.title: Date Range

dateTo.description: Filter articles published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with dateFrom.
dateTo.title: Date To

excludeWords.description: Words or phrases to exclude from results.
excludeWords.title: Exclude Words

extractFullText.description: Fetch each article and extract the full body text using trafilatura. Uses Playwright to render the article page.
extractFullText.title: Extract Full Article Text

includeImages.description: Extract the main og:image URL from each article page. Uses Playwright to render the article page.
includeImages.title: Include Article Images

language.description: 2-letter BCP-47 language code for Google News results (e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr', 'es').
language.title: Language

maxConcurrency.description: Number of parallel browser pages (for full text/images). Higher = faster but more memory.
maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of articles to return per query.
maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max Results Per Query

queries.description: One or more search keywords. Each query is processed separately. Results are deduplicated across queries.
queries.title: Search Queries

siteFilter.description: Restrict results to a specific domain (e.g. 'reuters.com', 'bbc.com').
siteFilter.title: Site Filter

title: Google News Scraper Input
